_comment: Template for appsettings.json. Copy to appsettings.json and fill in real values. appsettings.json is gitignored and must never be committed. In hosted environments prefer environment variables (ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection, Jwt__Secret) over a config file.

ConnectionStrings.DefaultConnection: Host=localhost;Port=5432;Database=hall_mgmt;Username=REPLACE_ME;Password=REPLACE_ME;SSL Mode=Disable;Trust Server Certificate=true;Maximum Pool Size=50;Minimum Pool Size=5;Connection Idle Lifetime=60;

Jwt._secretHowTo: Generate with: openssl rand -base64 64   (must be at least 32 characters; anything starting with CHANGE_ is rejected at startup)
